title: Flight delays
body: Narges builds a flight delay linear regression model. The dataset has $$400$$ flight records and $$10$$ columns (1 is the observed delay in minutes; $$9$$ are non-constant numerical features). Assume the least squares estimate is $$\hat{\theta}=(X**{T}X)**{-1}X**{T}Y$$ for design matrix $$X$$ (with intercept) and true output vector $$Y.$$
